scope: Independent source review and local focused tests. No implementation edits, model calls, credential reads, remote mutations or publication.

baseline.source: GitHub fetch_file at the exact commit; local Git was not used as authority after pack errors.

findings.title: Expose the discovered latest version
findings.details: The section sets latestVersion only after checkAndUpdateCardPack returns. That service returns only when installed.version equals remoteVersion, while the section displays Latest version only when latestVersion differs from installed.version. The latest-version row therefore cannot appear in a normal success. A newly discovered version is also lost when download fails because the service has no manifest-result callback.
findings.requestedFix: Show a successful remote check's latest version independently from installed confirmation, including while downloading and after a failed download. Keep Up to date gated on the existing verified installed-version condition.
findings.testGap: Existing service/UI tests assert current status and installed version but never assert that the latest version is visible.

findings.title: Recover a missing file despite matching install metadata
findings.details: When metadata buildId already matches the fresh remote version but the referenced local card file is missing, getInstalledDeckInfo returns null and the new flow calls installDeckAndInvalidate. Existing installDeckFromUrl at deckRepository.ts:792 returns true solely on matching metadata, without locating the file. The new readback remains null and reports not finished installing. Every retry follows the same path without a download.
findings.requestedFix: Make the existing same-version installer shortcut conditional on a valid located installed file, then preserve the normal installer validation/readback. Add a regression using the real repository path with matching metadata and a missing file.
findings.testGap: The new repository test proves that the installed-info accessor returns null for a missing file. The service tests mock the installer and do not exercise its same-version shortcut.

sourceBehaviorConfirmed: The explicit action uses requireRemote:true; fetch failure returns null and is promoted to an error instead of a cached Up to date result.
A server304 is accepted only after a real request with an existing manifest cache. The repository test asserts the conditional ETag request.
The accessor checks local file existence using the existing iOS container-relocation locator and exposes installedAtMs.
Duplicate presses are synchronously blocked by busy.current, with an independently passing UI test.
Settings keys the section by account and active slug. Mounted/request guards suppress a previous keyed section's eventual result; this is covered by an independently passing UI test.
The service compares auth generation after awaited phases, including installation and readback. No new progress or queue write calls appear in the feature.

Account changes before install and stale keyed UI results have focused tests. A real-account switch during native download was not exercised.
